name: Knowledgeable Connector
description: Ingestion + retrieval MCP connector for aw-knowledgeable (fredericowu/aw-knowledgeable), the standalone Neo4j knowledge-graph service — 7 tools mapped onto its API: upload_document, create_node, create_link, get_graph, list_documents, search_nodes (lexical name matching, for the link picker), search_graph (lexical/semantic/tree retrieval with the §12 knobs — beam_width, min_score, related_vias, bucket). This app is a thin HTTP client; it has no Neo4j driver and no knowledge of aw-knowledgeable's own tenant-isolation seam. Per docs/design/aw-knowledgeable-infra.md §10 (decision D2): the tenant a call lands in comes from THIS app's own shared service secret, never from the calling agent's self-asserted headers.

tasks.name: KB bulk-ingest — tick
tasks.prompt: The `KB bulk-ingest — tick` task (docs/design/aw-knowledgeable-v2-retrieval.md §13, git backend §16) just exited non-zero. Run `aw-workspace-cli knowledgeable-ingest status` and read the command's own stderr above to tell which case this is: (1) the §13.5.2 ignition guard blocked it because entity extraction is claiming — expected and fine, do not re-enable or disable anything, just note it; (2) a real HTTP/transport failure reaching aw-knowledgeable; (3) a batch of upload failures piling up in the journal; (4) git_state: no_secret — the git_token hasn't been set yet, expected until Frederico creates the PAT, just note it; (5) git_state: auth_failed — the PAT is missing/revoked/wrong, open a blocker so it gets rotated; (6) git_state: diverged — the mirror repo was edited outside this connector (or handed over non-empty) — NEVER force-push or merge to clear this, just report it and let a human resolve it on GitHub; (7) git_state: push_failed — report the detail, likely transient/network. Report which one, and only open a blocker if it's (2), (3), (5), or an ongoing (7) — not a single transient blip. Never run `aw-workspace-cli restart core` or touch `EXTRACTION_ENABLED`.

base_url.title: aw-knowledgeable base URL
base_url.description: Reached by container NAME on aw-stack-net, never an IP (docs/design/aw-knowledgeable-infra.md §10, D2 Q2). aw-host sits on aw-stack's own Docker network, so this resolves from inside aw-app-mcp-gateway as long as the aw-knowledgeable compose service declares an explicit container_name/alias matching this host.

service_secret.title: Service secret
service_secret.description: The X-Internal-Secret this connector authenticates every call with. Must equal aw-knowledgeable's own KNOWLEDGEABLE_SERVICE_SECRET, which that service maps 1:1 to one KNOWLEDGEABLE_SERVICE_TENANT_ID — never a caller-supplied header (D2 §Q3). Stored in the workspace secret store, read fresh on every tool call so a rotated secret needs no restart.

git_remote_url.title: Git backend — remote URL
git_remote_url.description: docs/design/aw-knowledgeable-fs-sync.md §16. An HTTPS repo URL (e.g. https://github.com/fredericowu/knowledge-base-private.git) that each sync tick commits and pushes knowledge_base/ to. A userinfo-bearing URL (https://user:token@...) is rejected — put the credential in the Git token field below instead. Empty disables the git backend entirely: no git_state is ever recorded.

git_branch.title: Git backend — branch
git_branch.description: The branch this connector pushes to, fast-forward-only. A non-fast-forward rejection (someone edited the mirror on GitHub, or the remote was handed over non-empty) is surfaced as git_state: diverged and never force-pushed.

git_token.title: Git backend — token
git_token.description: A fine-grained GitHub PAT scoped to the one repo above, Contents read/write only. Stored in the workspace secret store (never in git_remote_url, never on disk, never in argv), injected per git invocation as an environment-only Authorization header. Read fresh every tick — rotation needs no restart.

auth_required.title: Require workspace identity on every route
auth_required.description: Must be set to false for GET /keys/{slot} (docs/design/knowledgeable-apmt-key-pull-through.md) to answer production aw-knowledgeable, which holds no workspace session or API key — only the shared X-Internal-Secret. This flag is app-wide, not per-route, so every OTHER route in routes.py carries its own explicit _require_identity dependency to stay protected once this is false; do not add a new route here without the same guard.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'knowledgeable' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan knowledgeable/mcp.json.
